text:
Situation: Methylprednisolone acetate injection has been on FDA's shortage list since 2021-12-15 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Multiple manufacturers including Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Eugia US LLC, Par Health USA LLC, Pfizer Inc., and Sagent Pharmaceuticals are listed with current shortage status. Eugia US LLC updated 2026-10-19 with recovery TBD and advises checking wholesalers for inventory. Pfizer Inc. updated 2026-09-21 and Sagent Pharmaceuticals updated 2026-10-08, both remain current. Corvale Lakeside holds 11 vials of 40 mg/mL 5 mL (5.9 days) and 15 units of 4 mg (8 days). Corvale General holds sufficient stock (23 days on hand) to support a transfer.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2021-12-15; the listing is still current as of 2026-10-21. Eugia US LLC updated 2026-10-19 with recovery TBD. Pfizer Inc. updated 2026-09-21. Sagent Pharmaceuticals updated 2026-10-08.

Our position: Corvale Lakeside is below target days on hand for key presentations. Corvale General can spare inventory without dropping below two weeks. Alternative suppliers are not on FDA's shortage list and their labels do not identify a manufacturing plant we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Execute transfer of 27 units from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Continue monitoring FDA shortage page and manufacturer updates for recovery timelines — requires buyer to track and report weekly.
3. Evaluate therapeutic alternatives with clinical pharmacists for P&T review — requires P&T committee approval before any formulary change.

Not recommended: Purchasing from A-S Medication Solutions, Asclemed USA Inc., Caplin Steriles Limited, or Cardinal Health 107 LLC at this time due to absence from FDA shortage list and unverifiable manufacturing source.
